headline: India's Bank Nifty Reaches Record High as Equities Rally
summary: Broad institutional buying lifted India's Nifty index past the 25,450 level, while the Bank Nifty index scaled a fresh record high. Banking stocks drove the advance as easing crude oil prices and a stronger rupee supported domestic sentiment.
why: India's equity markets are among the largest in Asia, with the Bank Nifty index reflecting the performance of top private and public sector commercial lenders.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Plunging oil prices and foreign inflows lifted banking shares, powering broad index gains.
